name: Girona (Spain)
description: Nine horizontal stripes, five yellow and four red, charged at the centre with the Iberian shield of the arms vairy of white and red waves.
history: The flag was approved on 5 December 2013 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6523 of 17 December 2013; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into nine equal stripes, five yellow and four red alternating, with the quadrangular Iberian escutcheon vairy of white and red waves of the arms at the centre.

features.role: Iberian shield vairy of white and red waves, the arms of the city
